# 8831 - TRI-STATE line driver, quad single-ended or dual differential

Package DIP-16 · family 8800 · catalogue file [catalog/chips/8831.json](https://github.com/RetroCoreLabs/RetroSchematic/blob/master/src/catalog/chips/8831.json)

## Symbol

| As printed in ND-13.003.01, page 52 | Drawn in ND style | Drawn in modern style |
|---|---|---|
| ![8831 as printed in the 1976 symbol manual](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/8831.png) | ![8831 drawn in nd style](../../../catalog/symbols/nd1976/shapes/block-8831.png) | ![8831 drawn in modern style](../../../catalog/symbols/modern/shapes/block-8831.png) |

A rectangle for the whole function (or one section of it). Pin numbers are written on the lines where they meet the box; signal names are written beside them.

How to tell it on a drawing: Read the part type from the parts list and compare the pin numbers against this cut-out.

All symbols: [symbol catalogue](../../SYMBOL-CATALOG.md).

## Pins

| Pin | Name | Role | Active | Output type | Details |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | B_DIS1 | enable | low |  | controls pins 3, 5; when not enabled: float; "B" output disable, NOR with pin 2 |
| 2 | B_DIS2 | enable | low |  | controls pins 3, 5; when not enabled: float |
| 3 | OUT_B2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by B_DIS1,B_DIS2 |
| 4 | IN_B2 | input |  |  |  |
| 5 | OUT_B1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by B_DIS1,B_DIS2 |
| 6 | IN_B1 | input |  |  |  |
| 7 | MODE2 | input |  |  | differential/single-ended mode control |
| 8 | GND | ground |  |  |  |
| 9 | MODE1 | input |  |  | differential/single-ended mode control |
| 10 | IN_A1 | input |  |  |  |
| 11 | OUT_A1 | output |  | three-state | enabled by A_DIS1,A_DIS2 |
| 12 | IN_A2 | input |  |  |  |
| 13 | OUT_A2 | output |  | three-state | enabled by A_DIS1,A_DIS2 |
| 14 | A_DIS2 | enable | low |  | controls pins 11, 13; when not enabled: float |
| 15 | A_DIS1 | enable | low |  | controls pins 11, 13; when not enabled: float; "A" output disable, NOR with pin 14 |
| 16 | VCC | power |  |  | +5 V |

## Functions

| Output pin | Formula | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| 11,5 | OUT_x1 = IN_x1 XOR (MODE1 OR MODE2) when x_DIS1' AND x_DIS2'; Z otherwise | Channel 1 of each pair passes its input straight through when both mode inputs are 0 and inverts it when either is 1 (differential mode). Floats when either disable input of its side is 1. |
| 13,3 | OUT_x2 = IN_x2 when x_DIS1' AND x_DIS2'; Z otherwise | Channel 2 always passes its input non-inverted; floats when either disable input of its side is 1. Tie IN_x1 to IN_x2 for a differential pair. |

## Electrical

| Value | Figure |
|---|---|
| outputLowMaxCurrentMa | 40 |
| outputHighMaxCurrentMa | -40 |
| inputSchmitt | no |
| notes | DS8831: VOL 0.5 V max at 40 mA (0.4 V at 32 mA); VOH 1.8 V min at -40 mA, 2.4 V min at -5.2 mA. Has VCC clamp diodes (DS8832 does not). |

## Propagation delays

All measured at VCC 5 V, TA 25 C.

| From | To | Edge | Typ ns | Max ns |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| IN/MODE | OUT | PHL | 13 | 25 |
| IN/MODE | OUT | PLH | 13 | 25 |
| DIS | OUT | PHZ | 6 | 12 |
| DIS | OUT | PLZ | 14 | 22 |
| DIS | OUT | PZH | 14 | 22 |
| DIS | OUT | PZL | 18 | 27 |

## Not known

- No minimum delays printed.
- Load conditions for the switching table are on the waveform page (CL 50 pF / 5 pF jig) and were only partly legible.

## Notes

Mode pins 7 and 9 both feed one NOR gate shared by both sides.

## Sources

- [National Semiconductor 1975 Interface Integrated Circuits, DS7831/DS8831, DS7832/DS8832 TRI-STATE line driver](https://www.bitsavers.org/components/national/_dataBooks/1975_National_Interface_Integrated_Circuits.pdf) - pdf 110-113 (printed 3-37..3-40); DS8831
